field_discoveries.finding: The isolated TruePanel virtualenv does not contain the appliance-owned truenas_api_client package.
field_discoveries.resolution: Use the governed host-Python bridge while preserving the passive allowlist, private credential pipe, TLS verification, and fail-closed behavior.

field_discoveries.finding: TrueNAS replication.query may contain datetime.datetime values that are not JSON-native.
field_discoveries.failure_mode_before_fix: replication.query was dropped across the governed helper boundary, leaving AEGIS with zero visible successful tasks and an invalid receipt result.
field_discoveries.resolution: Serialize only standard datetime/date/time objects as ISO-8601 while continuing to reject arbitrary unknown objects.

conclusion: The governed AEGIS passive runtime completed production deployment and receipt-backed acceptance on BattleStation. It remained least-privilege, read-only, fresh-evidence-only, zero-control-authority, and zero-runtime-write while the deployed system and storage pools remained healthy.
